info.description:
The Wise Platform API is a REST-based interface that enables programmatic access to Wise's payment infrastructure. All endpoints return JSON-formatted responses and use standard HTTP methods and status codes, except the browser-based [SAML](/api-reference/saml) single sign-on endpoints, which return XML metadata or redirects. {% admonition type="success" name="New to wise?" %} We strongly recommend first reading our **[Getting Started Guide](/guides/developer/index.md)** to help you set up credentials and make your first call. {% /admonition %} Before you begin {% .title-2 .m-t-5 %} To use this API reference effectively, you should have: - Received Valid [API credentials from Wise](/guides/developer/auth-and-security/index.md) (Client ID and Client Secret) - Understand OAuth 2.0 authentication - Be familiar with RESTful API concepts We recommend connecting to our Docs MCP Server. {% connect-mcp /%} Core API resources {% .title-2 .m-t-5 .m-b-0 %} | Resource | Purpose | |----------|---------| | **[Quote](/api-reference/quote)** | Exchange rate and fee calculations | | **[Recipient](/api-reference/recipient)** | Beneficiary account management | | **[Transfer](/api-reference/transfer)** | Payment creation and execution | | **[Balance](/api-reference/balance)** | Multi-currency account operations | | **[Profile](/api-reference/profile)** | Account ownership details | | **[Rate](/api-reference/rate)** | Current and historical exchange rates | **Not sure which workflow to build?**
Start with our [Integration Guides](/guides/product/send-money/use-cases/index.md) for step-by-step implementation examples.{% .m-t-3 .m-b-5 %}

text.about_md:
**Versions.** Wise versions the whole API by quarter, in the URL. This SDK is
generated from version `2026Q4`: Production is `https://api.wise.com/2026Q4`, the default,
and the Sandbox is `https://api.wise-sandbox.com/2026Q4`.

**Credentials.** Most calls take a bearer token, passed as the `apikey` option: a
personal API token (Wise.com > Settings > Connect and manage apps > API tokens), a user
access token, or a client-credentials token for a Wise Platform partner. A partner's client
ID and secret come from Wise when the partnership begins. Each operation's own
documentation says which tokens it accepts.

```ts
import { WiseSDK } from '@voxgig-sdk/wise-sdk'

// The Sandbox. Without `base` the SDK calls Production.
const base = 'https://api.wise-sandbox.com/2026Q4'

// The currencies Wise supports. The live API answers this one without a token.
const open = new WiseSDK({ base })
const currencies = await open.Currency().list()
console.log(currencies.map((currency) => currency.data().code))

// Every other call sends the token as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
const client = new WiseSDK({ base, apikey: process.env.WISE_API_TOKEN ?? '' })
const profiles = await client.Profile().list()
for (const profile of profiles) {
  console.log(profile.data())
}
```

**Scope.** Every one of the 229 operations in Wise's published definition is here. Where
one entity has several routes for the same operation, an action tells them apart, selected
with `$action` in the request data: a card PIN is `$action: 'pin'` on
`CardSensitiveDetail`, a one-time-token challenge is `'sms'`, `'voice'` or
`'whatsapp'`, and each sandbox `Simulation` is named for what it simulates, such as
`'balance-topup'`. Two signing schemes the definition declares, HMAC request signatures
and JOSE payload encryption, are not applied for you: the operations that need them say so
in Wise's documentation.

**No MCP server.** Wise runs its own hosted MCP server for its API, so this SDK does not
generate one. The SDKs and the CLI are all here.

**Not yet run with a token.** The only live calls so far are to `Currency().list()`, on
Production and the Sandbox, which the live API answers without a token. Every other
request was checked against a local server answering from the definition. Wise's
descriptions are written in Redocly's Markdoc, and one parameter description in the
generated documentation still shows an `admonition` tag as text.
